flashcard_questions.q: What is the defining feature of a eukaryotic cell?
flashcard_questions.a: It has a true nucleus enclosed by a membrane.

flashcard_questions.q: Where is the genetic material found in a prokaryotic cell?
flashcard_questions.a: In a single loop of DNA floating in the cytoplasm.

flashcard_questions.q: What is a plasmid in a bacterial cell?
flashcard_questions.a: A small ring of extra DNA that can replicate independently.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the function of the mitochondria in a cell?
flashcard_questions.a: The site of aerobic respiration, transferring energy from glucose.

flashcard_questions.q: Which organelle is the site of protein synthesis?
What does the cell membrane control?
flashcard_questions.a: Which substances enter and leave the cell.

flashcard_questions.q: Which plant organelle contains chlorophyll and carries out photosynthesis?
What is the plant cell wall made of?
What does the permanent vacuole of a plant cell contain?
flashcard_questions.a: Cell sap, a weak solution of sugars and salts.

flashcard_questions.q: Why does a sperm cell contain many mitochondria?
flashcard_questions.a: To supply the energy needed for swimming to the egg.

flashcard_questions.q: How does a root hair cell absorb more water and mineral ions?
flashcard_questions.a: Its long thin extension increases the surface area.

flashcard_questions.q: Why can a cutting taken from a plant grow into a new plant?
flashcard_questions.a: Plant cells can differentiate throughout their lives.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the resolution of an electron microscope?
Magnification = size of image ÷ size of ____ ____.
Why is a coverslip lowered onto a slide at an angle?

notes: 15 cards: 3 term→definition (eukaryotic, plasmid, prokaryotic DNA), 5 structure→function organelle cards (mitochondria, ribosome, membrane, chloroplast, vacuole), 2 specialised-cell adaptation cards (sperm, root hair), 1 cloze on the magnification formula, 1 value-and-unit (electron microscope resolution), 2 practical technique cards (coverslip angle, plant differentiation).
